blocks.text: Filipino-Irish-British model Christina Nadin surprised fans after she appeared at the 2026 Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show, making history as the second Filipino woman to walk the runway of the annual fashion event. Nadin made her debut during the PINK segment held on Monday, Oct. 19 (Sunday, Oct. 18 in the United States). In an earlier post on her Instagram page, Nadin celebrated the feat, showing a cake with “Congrats! VS Angel!” written on it.
